blocks.content: After creating an alert rule, you can monitor it in the alert rules list. The list shows two key pieces of information: rule state and rule health.
To view your alert rules, complete the following steps:
Navigate to **Alerts & IRM > Alerting > Alert rules**.

Grafana-managed rules are organized hierarchically: **Folder > Rule group > Individual rules**.

Find your rule in the folder you chose earlier.

Check two indicators for your rule:

| Indicator | Values | What it tells you |
|-----------|--------|-------------------|
| **Rule state** | Normal, Pending, Firing | Whether any instances are active |
| **Rule health** | Ok, Error, No Data, KeepLast | Whether evaluation is running correctly |
Use filters to narrow the list by name, label, folder, evaluation group, data source, contact point, rule state, or rule health.
You can see your alert rule's current state and health. For deeper monitoring workflows like viewing state history and inspecting active notifications, refer to the Alert Response course.
